querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      rc_50d,
                                      mi_a12d,
                                      mi_mi12d,
                                      micd_dif,
                                      micd_micd,
                                      rccd_dif,
                                      rccd_rccd,
                                      srmi_9d,
                                      atr_tr14d,
                                      atr_atr14d,
                                      mass,
                                      vhf,
                                      cvlt,
                                      adtm_adtm,
                                      adtm_adtmma,
                                      bias,
                                      kdj_k,
                                      kdj_d,
                                      kdj_j,
                                      rsi,
                                      cci,
                                      dbcd_dbcd,
                                      dbcd_mm,
                                      dpo,
                                      dpo_madpo,
                                      lwr1,
                                      lwr2,
                                      roc,
                                      roc_rocma,
                                      si,
                                      slowkd_k,
                                      slowkd_d,
                                      wr,
                                      bias36,
                                      bias612,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_ashareswingreversetrend.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.ashareswingreversetrend WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
